Description

[7:0] SELECT_SIGNAL rw 0x0 -

Field Descriptions

SELECT_FREQ_DIV

Select Frequency Divider for debug monitor output pin. Division ratios: 0=div1 (no division), 1=div2, 2=div4, 3=div8, 4=div16, 5=div32, 6=div64, 7=div128. Used to slow down high-frequency signals for external observation. Default=0 (no division).

SELECT_SIGNAL

Select Signal. Selects one of 256 internal signals to route to the external debug monitor pin. Signal mapping: [0-11]: Raw noise bits from generators 0-11 (1 bit per generator). [12-15]: Reserved/padding. [16-27]: Divided sample clocks from generators 0-11 (1 bit per generator). [28-31]: Reserved/padding. [32-63]: Compressed 32-bit entropy stream (BIW extractor output). [64-95]: FIFO input 32-bit entropy stream (pre-FIFO buffering). [96-127]: Reserved/padding. [128-223]: Uncompressed per-generator entropy bytes (96 bits total): Generator 0 byte [135:128], Generator 1 byte [143:136], Generator 2 byte [151:144], Generator 3 byte [159:152], Generator 4 byte [167:160], Generator 5 byte [175:168], Generator 6 byte [183:176], Generator 7 byte [191:184], Generator 8 byte [199:192], Generator 9 byte [207:200], Generator 10 byte [215:208], Generator 11 byte [223:216]. [224-255]: Reserved/padding.
